submission.reason: Exploration of data/explore.csv showed all ten candidate exposures had weak associations with tensile_mpa after adjusting for lab. The strongest linear signal was carbon_pct (OLS with lab indicators: coef=-0.21, p=0.11; Spearman p=0.018; spline F-test p=0.04), so it was selected as the single hypothesis. The pre-registered confirmatory OLS on held-out data gave estimate=-0.204, SE=0.115, p=0.076, which is not significant at alpha=0.05. Therefore no direct effect is confirmed.

df = pd.read_csv('data/explore.csv')
cands = ['anneal_temp','cool_rate','carbon_pct','chromium_pct','grain_size','humidity','press_time','nickel_pct','porosity','cure_hours']
# robust regression (Huber) per candidate
import statsmodels.api as sm
for c in cands:
    d = df.dropna(subset=[c,'tensile_mpa']).copy()
    X = pd.get_dummies(d[['lab']], drop_first=True).astype(float)
    X[c] = d[c].values
    X = sm.add_constant(X)
    r = sm.RLM(d['tensile_mpa'].values, X, M=sm.robust.norms.HuberT()).fit()

import pandas as pd, numpy as np, statsmodels.formula.api as smf
from patsy import dmatrix
df = pd.read_csv('data/explore.csv')
cands = ['anneal_temp','cool_rate','carbon_pct','chromium_pct','grain_size','humidity','press_time','nickel_pct','porosity','cure_hours']
# spline F-test for each candidate
for c in cands:
    d = df.dropna(subset=[c,'tensile_mpa']).copy()
    m0 = smf.ols('tensile_mpa ~ C(lab)', data=d).fit()
    spl = dmatrix(f"bs({c}, df=5, degree=3)", d, return_type='dataframe')
    X = pd.concat([pd.get_dummies(d['lab'],drop_first=True).astype(float), spl], axis=1)
    import statsmodels.api as sm
    X = sm.add_constant(X)
    m1 = sm.OLS(d['tensile_mpa'].values, X).fit()
    # F test comparing to lab-only
    f = m1.compare_f_test(m0)
    print(f"{c:14s} F={f[0]:6.3f} p={f[1]:.4f}")
